scope: Slovak hint accuracy and alignment with the selected Spanish sense; no audio review.

entries.notes: Dôkladne posúdiť and starostlivo zvážiť hodnotu preserve careful assessment of testimonial worth; neither implies assaying metal or proving the accusation.
Rozhodnúť spor and vyriešiť spornú otázku match resolving the departmental controversy about spending authorization. The revised example strengthens the disputed-issue reading.
Presne rozlíšiť captures the conceptual boundary between political and administrative responsibility; vymedziť is a useful supporting gloss without implying acquittal.
Vyvodiť and usúdiť z indícií preserve inference rather than knowledge; the Spanish negation correctly denies that silence licenses the conclusion.

Dvojznačnosť formulácie identifies linguistic ambiguity in whether the representative grants or receives authorization. It does not add deliberate deception; DLE distinguishes that optional rhetorical sense.
Výhrada and obmedzujúce spresnenie preserve qualified assent, including the dependency of dates on permission, without implying wholesale rejection.
Bez okolkov is idiomatic Slovak for direct speech; priamo is supported by the no-evasion definition and does not add hostility.
Jemne rozlišovať and dôkladne rozoberať detaily fit distinguishing criticism of a method from attacking its user; metaphor is not translated literally.

Resolved r1: Spanish definition now explicitly selects unnecessary complication, matching zbytočne to ešte komplikovať and the fourth-signature example. Neutral refinement is no longer mixed into the selected sense.

Naraziť na seberovného súpera and nájsť si svojho majstra retain meeting effective resistance. Revised encontrar wording and encontró surface leave that sense unchanged; no literal shoe interpretation is implied.
The explicit získať vlastný prospech now preserves calculated self-benefit as well as intention; mentioning the vacancy to the director is a plausible self-serving maneuver.
The hint retains seeking benefit while avoiding accompanying risk; it fits supporting the protest privately without public commitment.
Prihrievať si vlastnú polievočku is an idiomatic counterpart to self-serving advocacy; the first gloss explains the benefit without literal fire imagery.
Dodatočne, keď už pominula možnosť konať now specifically retains the missed opportunity to act. The example supplies hindsight advantage and irony without requiring a literal completed bullfight.

Resolved r1: pre určitú vlastnosť is clarified by z opatrnosti, matching the prudent person missing an opportunity; vzhľadom na to, že je offers a general causal paraphrase without a masculine past-tense restriction. The introductory fragment appropriately expects a following complement.
Resolved r1: uprednostneného cieľa preserves prioritizing a purpose without declaring it morally higher. V záujme remains a natural concise equivalent in the transparency example.
Vzhľadom na and berúc do úvahy both preserve considering an already expired deadline; neither implies automatic causal inevitability.
Navyše correctly adds corroboration, and na ďalšie podporenie argumentu explains its formal argumentative function; the missing date correspondence adds a separate reinforcing reason.
Ak dovolíte tú významovú nadbytočnosť functions as a metalinguistic acknowledgement seeking tolerance for the redundant wording, matching the example.
S dovolením is natural and the explicit formal request-for-floor parenthesis preserves the ceremonial register rather than implying agreement.

Ponúknuť niečo len zo slušnosti, bez skutočného úmyslu to splniť accurately captures the narrowed perfunctory-offer sense. Excuses after offering moving help support lack of genuine commitment, rather than merely quiet speech.
The hint preserves both causing harm/conflict and hiding responsibility. Vlastnú účasť is understood as culpable involvement through the first clause.

Resolved r1: the two Slovak clauses convey retracting or changing an assertion without requiring an exact opposite or making self-interest necessary. First-person wording mirrors the fixed saying; the Spanish example shows its third-party critical use.
Múdremu stačí naznačiť is a natural proverb equivalent and keeps inference from a hint; the threatening force is correctly supplied by the contract-renewal context.
Akoby and zdanlivou preserve apparent casualness and leave room for actual intent; the job question demonstrates the indirect maneuver.
Ak nie rovno and aby som nepovedal naturally introduce the stronger accusation while presenting it as restrained; neither reads as literal prohibition on speaking.
Premôcť sa is particularly apt for congratulating a rival despite disappointment; the second gloss retains courage plus inner resistance without suggesting emotional absence.
Udržiavať si odstup vo vzťahu preserves interpersonal reserve, not physical distance, and fits maintaining a professional authority boundary.
The Slovak causal purpose clause preserves accommodation to avoid conflict; it does not imply endorsement of either party’s accusations.

Hrdosť na vlastnú česť, ktorá podnecuje k úsiliu a prekonávaniu sa preserves honor-based motivation to maintain standards and improve oneself. Finishing carefully despite no expected reproach fits intrinsic self-respect; the hint does not reduce pundonor to pride after success.

The revised pretrvávajúca vnútorná horkosť či nepríjemný pocit captures lingering inner discomfort after exclusion. It permits residual pain after accepted apologies without requiring active resentment; the previous awkward zvyšková collocation is gone.
Nevraživosť and nepriateľský odpor preserve hostility toward the author rather than intellectual disagreement with the book.

Drobné písmo now directly matches the definition’s smaller print, while nenápadné, ale dôležité podmienky explains the practical force of the advance-notice clause. Both literal format and consequential conditions are preserved.
Skrytá vada is the appropriate lexical counterpart for a defect not apparent in ordinary examination. This is language correspondence, not verification of jurisdiction-specific legal rights.
Zostať len na papieri is idiomatic and nemať praktický účinok explains lack of implementation; Spanish puede correctly leaves failure as a possibility.
Naťahovať vybavenie výhovorkami retains deliberate stalling; odkladať odpoveď is anchored by that first gloss and the repeated changing explanations.
Vedome privrieť oči nad prehreškom is idiomatic and explicitly preserves intentional tolerance rather than accidental failure to notice.

S výhradami precisely translates the reservation sense and bez bezvýhradného prijatia tvrdenia explains withholding full acceptance. Requesting a written delivery date fits cautious belief, distinct from rejecting the promise, frivolity or the separate inheritance-law construction.
Presne vzaté and v prísnom zmysle preserve strict formulation, especially association versus causality, without suggesting secrecy.
Both Slovak phrases preserve the remaining possibility of later revision and do not imply that the provisional text causes damage. The gloss is tailored to the selected example.

The explanatory predpokladanie toho, čo sa má dokázať now aligns with an unmistakably circular repeated-premise example. Logický kruh remains a familiar supplementary label without changing the selected fallacy.
The paraphrase identifies refuting a distorted version of another position and avoids a literal straw-man translation. The example preserves regulation versus absolute prohibition.
Úspornosť vysvetlenia and minimum potrebných predpokladov match the explanatory-economy sense, rather than slowness, stinginess or low evidence quality.

Resolved r1: domnelý príčinný vzťah explicitly restricts the false link to causation. The revised example permits a genuine association due to a third variable and no longer invites denial of any real statistical relationship or underlying cause.
Útočiť na toho, kto už padol preserves attacking a weakened person; zneužívať cudzie nešťastie is anchored by that precise first gloss and the mocking-ruin example.
Dymová clona is a natural figurative equivalent and the explanatory second gloss captures concealment through distraction; the Spanish appearance marker leaves intention uncertain.

Veľkolepé gesto či sľub, o ktorom sa vie, že nič neprinesie retains knowing ineffectiveness alongside impressive presentation. The revised speaker knowingly lacks funding, so this is not merely an uncertain or sincerely hopeful promise.
Lákavý, ale klamlivý či nebezpečný prísľub retains attraction plus deception/danger; the selected guaranteed-return example specifically supports the promise wording.
Oslavný prejav či text names the praise genre and chválospev is a useful equivalent; neither makes every instance necessarily insincere despite the critical example.
Hanobenie and prudká slovná hana retain forceful personal censure without requiring obscenity. Hana is literary in tone and suitable to the formal headword; direct JULS corroboration was unavailable.

method: Independent AI comparison of every Slovak hint with its Spanish definition and example. Contextual paraphrases are evaluated as sense hints, not full sentence translations. No human, native-speaker or official level approval is claimed. Final pass reread all 50 definition/example/hint combinations and assessed changes against the original snapshot; unchanged entries retain their substantive linguistic assessment. No final candidate edits were made by this reviewer.
finalFreezeDelta: After full learner-text re-review: evidence URLs corrected for rizar el rizo (/rizo), a fuer de (/fuer), and como quien no quiere la cosa (/cosa); English rationale for a beneficio de inventario revised to avoid overstating cuestionar as an open challenge. No definition, example or Slovak hint changed in this freeze delta.
